title: Coconut Red Curry Lentils
description: Red lentils simmered in coconut milk with red curry paste until they break down into a thick, spoonable stew. Vegan, deeply warming, and on the table in 30 minutes flat.

steps.text: Heat oil in a large pot or Dutch oven over medium heat. Add onion and cook, stirring occasionally, until softened and translucent, about 4 minutes.
Add garlic, ginger, and curry paste. Stir constantly until the paste darkens slightly and becomes very fragrant, about 1 minute.
Add lentils, coconut milk, vegetable broth, diced tomatoes, and salt. Stir well. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to medium-low.

Simmer uncovered, stirring occasionally, until lentils are completely broken down and the stew has thickened to a porridge-like consistency, 18 to 20 minutes. If it gets too thick before the lentils are tender, add a splash of water.
Fold in spinach and let it wilt into the curry, about 1 minute. Squeeze in the lime juice and taste — adjust salt as needed.
Serve in deep bowls over steamed rice or with warm naan, topped with cilantro.
